senses.gloss: (b. h.; onomatop.) to hiss, whistle; to quack.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 10">Ex. R. s. 10</cite> <he>צפרדע … ושָׁרְקָה להם וכ׳</he> there was one frog, and it quacked for them (other frogs), and they came; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 67b:21">Snh. 67ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 183:2">Yalk. Ex. 183</cite>.
